supabase.comment: Token resolution must not depend on how the app was launched. A Dock-launched app never sources ~/.zshenv, so ${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN} expands to nothing and the literal text reaches the server as its token. Keychain works either way; the env fallback keeps non-macOS clones working.
args: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s supabase-mcp -w 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN") exec node_modules/.bin/mcp-server-supabase --read-only --project-ref=namdkmsmdkmdffgscqgd
